# What must a GIPS Composite Report disclose about fees?

## 1. Answer

A GIPS Composite Report must disclose the fee schedule appropriate to the report's prospective client (4.C.11) and state whether returns are gross or net of fees, with what fees were deducted.

## 2. Requirements

| Requirement | Provision | Applies to | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Current fee schedule | 4.C.11 | Composite reports | Appropriate to the prospective client |
| Gross/net labelling | 4.A.3 | All reports | Label every return series |

## 3. Practical implications

- Ask for the fee schedule if the report omits it.
